notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We've just released a new update which removes the AVX2 requirement from the application.  We've replaced it with a warning message for users running older CPUs, as we can't guarantee good performance on hardware that doesn't meet our minimum specifications.  Thank you all for bearing with us, and thanks again for all of the excellent feedback!

-The Welcome to Light Fields team

notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hi all!

We've been very excited about all of the great feedback so far!  Thank you!

However, we realize that we didn't convey the CPU minimum specifications correctly.  Sorry!  We should have conveyed our requirements more clearly.  We require  Intel i5-4590 or newer.  More specifically, we require a CPU that supports the AVX2 instruction set.  We've updated the "System Requirements" text to make this more clear.  We've also updated the app to detect machines that don't support AVX2, display an error, and exit cleanly (rather than crash, which, we agree, was less than ideal).

Thank you all for your support and enthusiasm!
- the Welcome to Light Fields team
